summary: All 27,266 protocol records and 3,142 query-filter records agree with the supplied raw directory catalogue and filename parsing rules; the active retrieval route uses real dataset labels and standard AP/CMC percent scaling. All 205 launch-manifest entries match original raw bytes. Current supplemental source inspection resolves three import visibility gaps but cannot retroactively freeze them at launch. The recurrent-versus-mean comparison changes both state carry and final depth aggregation. No endpoint or stability certification is issued.
review_scope: Ground-truth catalogue/protocol provenance and static source/evaluation semantics only.
actual_backend_attestation: Unavailable: the reviewer runtime exposes no independent backend/model/effort attestation. Requested labels are not an attestation of actual backend routing.
trace_status: Parent is responsible for preserving the full native request/response trace; trace storage was not independently inspected in this call.
auditor: Native Codex reviewer; gpt-6-astra and max requested, actual backend not independently attested.

source_hash_verification.method: SHA-256 of raw file bytes, without newline decoding or normalization; additionally checked ZIP entries byte-for-byte against extracted files and the manifest.
source_hash_verification.source_authenticity_limit: These are byte-equality checks to supplied manifests and archive receipts, not image authentication, remote execution attestation, or independent verification of the original upstream repository.

deterministic_protocol_verification.method: Rebuilt every eligible primary record using the original parsers' filename/directory rules, compared every protocol field and companion path, checked split coverage, label-map bijections, identity overlap, and recomputed all query positive/excluded counts using dataset metadata only.
deterministic_protocol_verification.author_relabel_reproduction_limit: Original parsers enumerate a Python set rather than specifying a sorted class order. The RGBNT100 difference is a local CPython 3.11 reproduction from the sorted catalogue, not a reconstruction of the historical filesystem enumeration. All current protocol labels form a correct contiguous identity bijection.

gt_provenance.details: Dataset-provided identity/camera/scene labels, author split names and complete galleries are corroborated by all catalogue records. RGBNT201 has 3,951/836/836 rows, RGBNT100 8,675/1,715/8,575, MSVR310 1,032/591/1,055. All train labels match a sorted contiguous bijection, train/evaluation identities are disjoint, and every query has at least one retained positive. RGBNT100's sorted labels differ from an author-style set enumeration, but the active model creates a new classifier and bypasses the frozen Signal classifier, so this is not an observed target error.
gt_provenance.limitation: The collector captures names, file sizes and mtimes only, within protocol-selected splits. It does not hash or decode images, validate montage layout or identity truth, establish an authentic distribution download, prove absence of content duplicates, or prove that the same bytes were consumed at training/evaluation time. MSVR's sNNN field matches source scene filtering; actual chronology is not authenticated.

score_normalization.details: Active calls use upstream eval_func or eval_func_msrv and independently implemented camera_scores/scene_scores. AP averages rank precision over actual retained positives; mAP averages AP over valid queries; CMC averages binary cumulative matches. Reported scalars multiply these fractions by 100 only. Embedding L2 normalization and contextual attention softmax occur before distance/ranking and do not normalize reported performance by prediction maxima/minima/means. All frozen manifest hashes were checked on raw bytes.
score_normalization.limitation: No saved distance matrix or checkpoint was loaded and no performance number was recomputed; this PASS is for equations, static call routing and byte parity.

result_existence.details: Completed result-file existence, numeric claim matching, checkpoint contents, full50 completion, numerical reload agreement and training stability were not audited. Frozen manifest job entries are registration records, not execution-status evidence. Historical numerical statements in the plan are not endorsed.

active_dead_code.details: The CLI patches the context entry and then the base runner, so active build/train/evaluate/save/load refer to the cross-depth/context functions, not the older base training/evaluation definitions. The fused epoch scorer and the final three-output evaluator call actual dataset-label scorers; the collector requires three complete-gallery CPU recomputations. Depth mode, schema, protocol, baseline and condition are explicitly checkpoint-bound. Two material qualifications remain: three import-time modules were omitted from the launch manifest; and recurrent uses the final depth output while mean averages all three depth outputs.

scope.details: Registered scope is three datasets by three conditions, seed42, 50 epochs with official fused-mAP-best selection and latest exact-tie epoch. Source supports this protocol design, not completion. Official query/gallery labels influence checkpoint selection each epoch even though gradient losses use training labels only. Claims must describe a single-seed, post-selection development comparison and cannot establish unbiased held-out generalization, seed variance, a full completed panel, or persistence-only causality.

eval_type.details: The active retrieval route for fused/shared_global/joint_local is real_gt at the inspected source/protocol level: query and gallery identities/environment labels come from frozen dataset records, not model predictions. The M0 output-before/after-reload comparison is an explicitly labeled engineering consistency proxy, not retrieval performance. Dormant M3 teacher predictions are model-generated targets but are not enabled in this panel.

findings.title: Catalogue corroborates metadata, not image bytes
findings.required_followup: For a future data-byte authenticity claim, require authentic dataset manifests/content hashes or direct image evidence with a documented provenance chain; do not infer it from this catalogue.

findings.title: Three runtime imports lack launch-time source binding
findings.details: Their current raw bytes and import behavior were inspected in supplemental artifact 670 and match its SHA/size receipts. Relevant top-level imports/constants introduce no further unseen project import in the traced path. Their historical evaluation/training functions are dormant here. This resolves current semantic visibility, not launch-time freezing.
findings.required_followup: Retain an explicit limitation for existing runs; any future source-freeze claim should bind the complete import closure prospectively. Do not rewrite the historical manifest or imply supplemental current hashes were present at launch.

findings.title: Recurrent versus mean also changes depth aggregation
findings.details: depth_mean returns the average of three independent role outputs. depth_recurrent carries previous role outputs and returns only the final role output. Therefore their difference estimates the joint implementation change, not the isolated causal effect of recurrence.
findings.required_followup: Describe the exact joint change. A persistence-only causal claim would require a separately registered matched aggregation control; this review does not authorize or require changing the current frozen panel.

findings.title: Official-best selection uses evaluation labels
findings.details: Every training epoch evaluates official fused mAP and selects with >=, so official labels affect the chosen checkpoint. This is disclosed in the plan, but 'no test-label learning' must not be broadened to 'test-label-blind selection'.
findings.required_followup: Keep single-seed and post-selection qualifications; assess complete results and stability in a separate evidence-backed review.

context train -> runner.official_metrics -> extract all records -> distance_matrix -> author and independent scorers
cross-depth evaluate -> context evaluate -> depth-bound strict reload -> three output distances -> author and independent scorers

inactive_in_this_route: train_msvr310_signal_oof and train_rgbnt100_signal_oof standalone OOF training/evaluate_gallery routes (loaders and scene_scores/camera_scores are active)
R1_mAP and R1_mAP_eval wrapper classes, reranking and visualization helpers in author metrics
M3 teacher/prediction loss; auxiliary identity head when auxiliary_target=none; prediction_weight=0.1 is dormant in the context loss
TinySequenceMixer CPU substitute (production route injects production_mamba_factory)
active_route.initialization_only: The old V8 expert wrapper is constructed by build_model to obtain the strict baseline, then discarded; its historical evaluation/training route is not used.

mode_semantics.mixed_once: Uniformly average layer-normalized depth snapshots before nonlinear role adapters, then one _step.
mode_semantics.depth_mean: Apply the shared adapters/operators independently at all three depths with previous=None, then average three role outputs.
mode_semantics.depth_recurrent: Process the same three depths, adding the previous role output to the corresponding next role input, and use only the final output.
mode_semantics.common: Layer indices 3/7/11 (blocks 4/8/12); depth logits fixed at their uniform initialization; shared address rule computed once from the mixed Transformer-role CLS; same context conditioning and regional 1536D readout, with M1/M2 on and M3 off. Separate trained modes can learn different parameter values, addresses and shared-global features.

eval_routes.route: epoch fused and selected-checkpoint fused/global/local retrieval
eval_routes.claim_ceiling: Source/protocol classification only; actual endpoint values and data bytes unverified.

eval_routes.purpose: Engineering equivalence between original and reloaded model outputs; explicitly not retrieval performance.
Dormant training-only model-target consistency, not dataset retrieval GT.

eval_routes.route: CPU TinySequenceMixer/operator sanity checks mentioned by the plan

limitations: No SSH, GPU work, training, inference, project-module execution, dependency installation, source edit or old-receipt edit.
No image content, checkpoint state, saved embeddings, distance arrays, completed result receipts or training logs were inspected.
A catalogue produced after execution cannot prove the dataset bytes used during execution.
Current supplemental source bytes do not repair historical launch-time source binding.
Package version strings in receipt 668 are not package binary/source hashes or runtime attestation.
Source-level guards show intended checks, not that those checks ran successfully.
Same-family semantic judgment remains provisional; no cross-family independence is claimed.
verification_method: Read primary artifacts directly; used local standard-library Python and PowerShell for exhaustive catalogue/protocol arithmetic, AST import inspection, raw SHA-256 and ZIP comparisons. No project modules were imported.
